title: Chips filter component audit
purpose: Audit chips as a button-like option component with its own interaction expectations.
objective: Define chip anatomy, selected state, wrap behavior, optional icons/visuals, density, states, and customization backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: chip label, selected state, hover/focus, wrapping, spacing, compact mode, optional visuals, active affordance, and QA scenario. Out of scope: checkbox, radio, toggle, swatch, and implementation.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current chips render/CSS/JS files are available.
exit_condition: A chips audit sheet exists with layout, states, and style controls prioritized.
completion_criteria: Wrap and responsive behavior are documented.
Shared vs chip-specific controls are separated.

phases.title: States
phases.purpose: Define selected, hover, focus, disabled, and wrap behavior.

acceptance_criteria: Audit treats chips as button-like options, not generic checkboxes.
No plugin source changes are made.
stop_conditions: Chip selected state is visually underspecified.
